# $crav1-retire-spec

lane: cross-cutting | group: Keep the picture current | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.60.0 | prompts: 2
purpose: Take one spec out of the work (retire, merge, park, or convert to note), or un-park it.
use_when: A spec is done, dead, belongs in another spec, should wait, or is only reference knowledge
reads: Reads the named `docs/specs/<slug>/`, the other specs (for merge fits and links), `docs/system/landscape.md`, and `docs/notes/` (waiting notes on un-park).
writes: After a yes only. Retire and merge move the folder to `docs/specs/retired/<slug>/` and leave a `Moved:` pointer; merge also writes the target `spec.md`. Park writes a `Parked:` line. Un-park removes it, adds chosen points, and moves the slug from `waiting_for` to `used_by` on notes. Convert writes `docs/notes/YYYY-MM/<date>-<slug>.md`, the generated index, and one line under `## How the parts connect`. Retire, merge, and convert remove the feature-index row.
leaves alone: Never deletes a file. Leaves other specs alone (except the merge target) and does not rewrite inbound links; it lists them.
limits: no target fits a merge says `no good merge fit found` and offers park, retire, or convert to note. A converted note has no research owner, so no revisit request.
flow:
- **`$crav1-retire-spec`** takes one spec out of the work.
- It opens with one question: retire (Recommended), merge, park, or convert to note, and skips it when the wording answers.
- It always shows a summary of every change and waits for a yes.
- It never deletes; a moved spec leaves a one-line `Moved:` pointer at its old path.
- Retire moves the spec to `docs/specs/retired/` with a `Retired:` line, removes its feature-index row, and flags links to it.
- Merge takes a named target or suggests only real fits with a reason each (shared feature area, overlapping requirements, same system in landscape, links), best first, or says `no good merge fit found`; content, open questions, and decisions move over credited `(from <slug>)`.
- Park adds a `Parked:` line in place; plan, build, and ado-sync push skip it, and add-to-spec saves matching input as one note waiting for it.
- Un-park re-reads each waiting note in full and adds the spec to `Used by`.
- Convert to note writes `docs/notes/YYYY-MM/` with a `Source:` line and a landscape line, and regenerates the notes index.

## Choice words
- question: What to do
  - `retire`: retire
  - `merge`: merge
  - `park`: park
  - `convert-to-note`: convert to note
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls no skill.
you run next: nothing in particular
first: `$crav1-retire-spec retire docs/specs/<slug>/`
walkthrough: from-retire-spec.md
